title: A request mapped while it happens: "start maybe finding 10 different paths" to a storyteller, a motion agent and the traces they start from
summary: Dinis (~10:10), to the conductor: small animations that "explain the workflow, that explain how it was done", "a set of APIs and data structures so that I can use the same visual explanation ... on a specific event, on a specific set of actions for a specific agent"; "start maybe finding 10 different paths". One of his examples is this request itself: "map out everything that's going to happen from this request".

The conductor recorded it at 10:10:38 (f4071e9c) as two new agents, incident.storyteller@ (the cast, the primitives, ten paths, the arc) and incident.motion@ (one small data format for a flow, animations, a gallery at /flows/), and a full page each for the Universe and the live map (incident.observability@).

The storyteller's key was on dev 2 min 36 s after the record (edc481e0); the cast of 43 and the primitives at 5 min 22 s (8862c581); motion@'s format and first three animations at /flows/ at 10 min 30 s (b144acec); ten paths and the arc at 20 min 51 s (53a3368a, 10:31:29).

The reporter pointed both at the traces at 10:16:52; motion@ played all fourteen as they are 10 min 47 s later (4038053e), and the storyteller told two of Dinis's examples no trace held (a journalist's wake, a story made) and built path 5 on this trace. Nothing was traced twice.
Closed at 10:31:29. Dinis's next word (~10:30, the wind-down) came while it was finishing: the paths become part of the closing record (trace: wind-down-explorer-to-villager).
